speaker: Devotee (marveling)
question: Who knows how far your works reach?
premises: Of will alone: of whom this-much fruit, three-world-constituted.
Of him, of you, O lord — of works who knows how great the reach? (Vṛtti M00089: icchāmātreṇa, atarkya beyond reckoning).
inference: Mere will fruits as three worlds; your works' reach is unknowable.

option_choices.reason: T1 of-will kept; Vṛtti instrumental nuance (by mere will) noted in premises, form is genitive/ablative ambiguous.
iyat this-much (quantity of fruit) vs this; T1 fusion kept.
Genitive of-you with tasya (of him, of you); dative would orphan kāryāṇāṃ.
Reach/extent (how far works extend); course is same motion, T1 reach kept.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom do ladder-climbers bow?
premises: Even Brahmā and others hasten higher and higher by his work-stair-series.
To win the abode: to him I bow.
inference: I bow to him whose work-stair even Brahmā climbs.

option_choices.reason: Correlative that (whose stair); expletive would orphan yasya.

speaker: Devotee (blessing)
question: Who protects?
premises: 'This Brahmā, this Great Indra, these sun and moon' — thus blossomed as his power-creeper.
May that Bhava protect.
inference: May Bhava, whose power-creeper blossoms as gods, protect.

option_choices.reason: Quotative thus (labels the offices); so-saying is same iti, T1 kept.
Distal that-one beyond praise (asau); plain he loses distance.

speaker: Devotee (praising)
question: Whom do we praise — beyond error and reach?
premises: No delusion is found of him even by deluded hearts.

inference: We praise Mṛḍa, errorless and reachless.
uncertainties: astaṃ setting vs home/abode — literal only, needs Kṣemarāja collation; durgam impassable vs fortress kept literal.

option_choices.reason: Passive is-found (error occurring in him, not catching him).
End vs limit; T1 end kept, same boundary.
Impassable ground (no delusion found, no entry); fortress is same closure, T1 kept.
Setting kept literal; home/abode needs M00089, left open per uncertainties.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: Where bow — and to whom?
premises: Bow in praise, remembrance, meditation, seeing, touch, likewise attainment.
And to bliss-mass, to beloved, to matted-haired.
inference: Bow everywhere to the beloved bliss-mass, matted-haired.

speaker: Devotee (questioning pride)
question: What with pride, what with joy?
premises: 'What with pride?' having even thought with mind, O Supreme Lord.
'With pride I am made-of-you' — me(?) not in self — what with joy?
inference: Thinking pride, claiming made-of-you, yet not in self — what joy?
uncertainties: māmi parsing unknown (mām + emphatic? prohibitive mā?) — M00089 collation required; smayena pride vs smile; mudā with-joy vs for-joy; double kiṃ rhetorical.

option_choices.reason: Pride (arrogance at made-of-you claim) vs smile; T1 pride kept, smile needs Vṛtti.
Placeholder me-? kept; me reading needs M00089, AMBIGUOUS retained.
With-joy (instrumental accompaniment); for-joy purpose is same rite, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (resting)
question: Where rest from duty-crores?
premises: Having weighed even duty-crores, from mind's fickleness.
Resting, O Bhava, in your mind-bliss I delight greatly.
inference: Resting from countless duties in your mind-bliss, I delight.

option_choices.reason: Possessive your-mind-bliss (resting place); relational concerning-you is same locus, T1 kept.
Present I-delight (resting delight); optative is same wish, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (puzzling subtle/gross)
question: How subtle-part yet gross-unseen?
premises: If even subtle, how is this three-world a mere part of you?
If gross, then why not easily seen even by Brahmā and others, O lord?
inference: Subtle yet whole-part; gross yet unseen — how?

option_choices.reason: Mere-part (kalā as portion); moon-digit allusion is same smallness, T1 part kept.
Easily-seen (why not seen by Brahmā); fair-seeming is same visibility, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (reasoning word-nets)
question: Who would toil in word-nets?
premises: If this 'you indeed are their expressible' had not been.
What wise one, O god, would then have taken trouble in word-nets?
inference: Without you-as-expressible, no wise one would toil in words.

option_choices.reason: Expressible (predicate of you); to-be-spoken is same gerundive, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (begging teaching)
question: By what rite or wisdom are you seen?
premises: By which course, by which rite, or by which wisdom, O lord, are you visible?
By teaching show grace to me.
inference: Show by teaching which course makes you visible; grant grace.

option_choices.reason: By-course/method (means of seeing); gradually is same krama, T1 kept.
By-teaching (means of grace); as-teaching content is same instruction, T1 kept.
